description: Use when the user needs valid capability/process ids, category names, tiers or required equipment specs before searching suppliers or works. This is a curated L0 dictionary from grid_capabilities.csv and equipment_types.csv; it is not a supplier list.

capability_id.description: Filter by exact capability row id.

category_id.description: Filter by category id, e.g. cnc-machining.

equipment_type.description: Equipment type substring in English or Chinese.

name: list_supplier_capability_rows
